subject: TideTech renewal QBR & roadmap demo — slot planning
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Rhodes <claire@tidetech.com>, Manuel Cruz <m.cruz@tidetech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0500
Subject: TideTech renewal QBR & roadmap demo — slot planning

Hi Claire / Manuel,

We’re getting the renewal QBR scheduled and want to lock a one-hour roadmap demo tailored to TideTech’s expansion priorities. To make this low-friction for your execs, we’d like to run a short round-robin of 3 candidate slots spread across two weeks so you can pick what fits best. Proposed windows (US/PST):

- Option A: Wed Nov 10, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Option B: Thu Nov 11, 13:00–14:00 PT
- Option C: Tue Nov 16, 08:00–09:00 PT

Agenda (high level): 10m intros, 30m roadmap + targeted expansion features, 15m ops/SLAs/pricing Q&A, 5m next steps.

If any of the slots look tight, tell me who needs to attend and I’ll propose alternates. I’ll loop in our CS and product leads if you confirm a preferred window.

Thanks — looking forward,

Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0198

[attachment: QBR-agenda-v3.pdf]
From: Claire Rhodes <claire@tidetech.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Manuel Cruz <m.cruz@tidetech.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: TideTech renewal QBR & roadmap demo — slot planning

Hi Jordan — thanks for the options. Quick notes:

- Our Head of Product (Sara) is traveling Nov 10–12 and can’t make Option A or B.
- Execs in EMEA (Ira, Avni) are available Nov 16 but would prefer a later slot (11:00–12:00 PT) to avoid 3am local time.
- Manuel can do Nov 10 afternoon PT but only until 15:00 PT.

Given conflicts, could we either:
1) add a Nov 17 11:00–12:00 PT option as an EMEA-friendly time, or
2) split the session into two 45-min blocks (roadmap + ops) and offer one for Americas and one shifted for EMEA?

Also please send any pre-read you want stakeholders to scan.

—Claire
Claire Rhodes
Sr. Program Manager | TideTech
claire@tidetech.com
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Rhodes <claire@tidetech.com>, Manuel Cruz <m.cruz@tidetech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 13:24:00 -0500
Subject: Re: TideTech renewal QBR & roadmap demo — slot planning

Thanks Claire — good context. Looping in Marissa (CS lead) and Ben (product) to propose an ops-friendly approach.

Ben / Marissa — TideTech has travel and EMEA availability constraints. Two options to propose back:

A) Multi-week round-robin: run the full 60-min roadmap demo at three distinct week/day times and let the execs pick the best. Advantage: single session content, single recording. Disadvantage: more calendar churn.

B) Split-run: two 45-min sessions — one Americas-focused (roadmap + commercial Qs) and one EMEA-focused (tech deep-dive + ops). Advantage: smaller, time-zone tuned groups; Disadvantage: duplicate prep and recordings.

Can you propose exact alternate slots if we go with A, or confirm the split and who would present for B?

Jordan
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Claire Rhodes <claire@tidetech.com>, Manuel Cruz <m.cruz@tidetech.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 09:08:00 -0500
Subject: Re: TideTech renewal QBR & roadmap demo — slot planning

Quick take from product: I’d prefer Option B (split-run). Proposed schedule:

- Session 1 (Americas) — Nov 10, 13:00–13:45 PT: Roadmap + commercial tie-ins (Jordan + Ben)
- Session 2 (EMEA) — Nov 17, 11:00–11:45 PT: Technical deep-dive and deployment/SLAs (Marissa + Monica)

I’ll own the roadmap portion; Marissa/Monica can lead the ops/SLAs. I attached a slot matrix with times and attendee heatmap — helps show overlap. Also updated the agenda (QBR-agenda-v3.pdf).

If that works, Jordan can send a single calendar invite for each session and a consolidated pre-read link.

- Ben

- Please confirm attendee list for each session so we can limit the invite (execs only vs. extended team).

Proposed attendee breakdown:
- Session 1 (Americas): Claire, Manuel, TideTech Sales, Jordan, Ben
- Session 2 (EMEA): Ira, Avni, Sara (if available), Marissa, Monica

- Session 1: Nov 10, 13:00–13:45 PT (Americas) — attendees: Claire, Manuel, TideTech Sales reps.
- Session 2: Nov 17, 11:00–11:45 PT (EMEA) — attendees: Ira, Avni, Sara, and engineering leads.
